title: extract integrate run 결과 (v0)
description: 요구사항 추출 extract의 integrate run이 내는 결과 제안(requirements-extraction-flow.md 16.4, 결정 10·12, AI 결정 107~111). 앞선 run들의 기록을 전역 ID로 잇고(links: resolves, supersedes, merges, conflicts), 관점×구성의 빈칸(coverage)을 판정하고, 빈칸을 채울 단위를 제안한다. 연결은 상태를 올리지 않는다(결정 12). coverage의 키는 앱이 skills/extract/perspectives.md의 관점 ID로 채운다(결정 36의 꼴). 공통 $defs는 survey·trace와 같아야 한다(skills/check.mjs가 본다). 필드 설명은 지시의 필드 안내(L3)로 렌더링하므로 영어로 쓴다(16.2, D98).

outcome.description: done: you went through the record and judged every perspective. incomplete: deadline, limit or context ran out (checkpoint required).

outcome_reason.description: One or two sentences on why this outcome.

links.description: Links between records from earlier runs, by global ID.

coverage.description: Perspective by configuration coverage of the whole record. The app fills the keys with the perspective IDs for each run.

units.description: New analysis units for gaps nothing in the record reaches: an entry point, handler, command or perspective cell no unit has traced.

unknowns.description: What code cannot settle and needs outside material, measurement or a person. Things you could still trace in code go to followups (trace) or units (survey).

human_decisions.description: Only for the closed triggers. Plain lack of material is an unknown, not a decision.

checkpoint.description: Required when outcome is incomplete: where to resume. Otherwise null.

key.description: Local key, unique within this result (e.g. o1, q2). Other items point to it from refs.

refs.description: Keys of other items in this result.

configs.description: Configuration names this applies to, as named in the packet. Use the single name "all" only when a tool showed it is active in every confirmed configuration. Never merge behavior of different configurations into one item.

anchor.description: Where the evidence is. quote is a short verbatim copy of lines you opened in this run.

kind.description: code: source at the base commit. tool_output: output file of a tool you ran in scratch. doc_claim: a claim in a document or comment inside the repo. external_spec: material outside the repo (datasheet, standard).

path.description: Repo-relative path. For tool_output the output file in scratch; for external_spec the document id.

command.description: For tool_output the command you ran, otherwise null.

search.description: One search that supports an absence or a not_applicable.

tool.description: Tool used (Grep, Glob, a Bash command).

needs.description: What would settle it: external_doc (datasheet, spec), measurement (on real hardware), toolchain (a build or tool you could not run), other.

unit.description: A proposed analysis unit. Give priority, dependencies and the reason as data; the app picks the order.

trigger.description: Closed triggers only: scope_budget (widen scope or budget), shipping_config (which configuration ships cannot be told from code), product_intent (interpreting product intent), toolchain_material (a toolchain or material the intent did not provide).

gid.description: A global ID from the packet or the record listing: c-NNNN claim, u-NNNN unit, h-NNNN human decision. Never a local key.

link.description: A link between records from earlier runs, by their global IDs. A link shows a relation for a person to read; it does not confirm, close or remove anything.

kind.description: resolves: the to claims answer the unknown in from (say in reason whether wholly or partly). supersedes: the to claims replace the from claims about the same thing in the same configurations (a later, reopened or continued run looked again). merges: the from claims say the same as the to claim for the same configurations; the to claim is kept. conflicts: from and to cannot both hold.

from.description: Global IDs the link starts from. For resolves, the unknown.

to.description: Global IDs the link points to.

reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences.

anchors.description: Extra evidence you opened for this link; empty when the linked claims already carry it.

cell.description: One coverage judgement for some configurations. covered: ids required. not_applicable: searches required. unknown: you could not tell. unreached: nothing in the record reaches it; units names the units you propose for it.

ids.description: Global IDs of the claims or units that cover it.

units.description: Keys of units in this result proposed for it.

note.description: Short note; empty string if none.
